newsitem.title: USA: Safety 1st sees loss for Q4, '96 yr.
newsitem.headline: Safety 1st sees loss for Q4, '96 yr.

text.p: Safety 1st Inc said it expects to report a loss for the fourth quarter and 1996 fiscal year.
It said it expected sales for the fourth quarter to be in the range of $24-$26 million.

It said results have been "adversely impacted" in the fourth quarter due to lower-than-expected sales, primarily in its home security category, especially the IDR carbon monoxide detector that the company recently began to market.
It also cited "a decline in certain product margins." It did not elaborate.
It also said it was working with Goldman Sachs "to explore various alternatives to enhance shareholder value." It did not elaborate.
It posted a loss of $2.5 million, or $0.35 per share, on sales of $22.3 million for the fourth quarter of 1995.
For the 1995 year, it earned $3.2 million, or $0.45 per share.
